body:
Remediate post-PR-159 cross-model adversarial review findings:
1. bin/hook-runner.sh: resolve SYS_ID (/usr/bin/id or /bin/id) and SYS_FIND (/usr/bin/find or /bin/find) by absolute path so PATH manipulation cannot spoof owned_by_euid() or CUR_UID; resolve REAL_PASSWD_HOME via absolute system getent/dscl/cut/awk and prepend /usr/bin:/bin to PATH when RUNNER_ROOT resides inside REAL_PASSWD_HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/*; update the fallback active-ticket grep to recognize "completed": true alongside terminal status values.
2. test/hook-runner.test.mjs: verify PATH-shadowed find and id cannot spoof owned_by_euid() or CUR_UID, verify owned_by_euid() rejects foreign-UID system paths (/etc when euid != 0), and verify fallback active-ticket detection treats completed:true shards as inactive.
3. lib/agy.mjs + dist/*: document why macOS Seatbelt (sandbox_init nested sandbox restriction) omits inner agy --sandbox alongside Linux bwrap, and rebuild dist bundles.
title: Pin system find/id/getent in hook-runner.sh, recognize completed:true shards in fallback, and document macOS Seatbelt nested sandbox omission
